profile.headline: Test Automation Engineer at Changeis, Inc.
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer delivering resilient, scalable applications across mission-critical public sector systems, built with the speed and ownership of modern product development.

Outside my day job, I build independent software through Hernandez Tech Solutions, LLC, currently developing my first product, chordamigo.com, as a solo venture. Passionate about seamless integrations and end-to-end execution. Always open to connecting with fellow builders.

Disclaimer: Solo projects and views shared here are strictly my own, developed independently outside of work hours via Hernandez Tech Solutions, LLC, and are not affiliated with or endorsed by my employer.

positions.description: (Perspecta formerly DXC Technology U.S. Public Sector)

positions.title: AP CS MOOC Workshop Leader
positions.description: Lead high school students through an online Java programming course.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description: Worked with a small software development team. I used JavaScript, JQuery and Python to help write client side and server side code to fix bugs, maintain and upgrade a Django application: The Satellite Irrigation Management Support. The application uses satellite data to map crop canopy conditions and daily crop water requirements across California in near-real-time.

company.name: California State University, Monterey Bay / NASA Coop

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
I worked on a python program that created KML files from different sources, such as GPS data retrieved by web scraping and CSV files. I upgraded a website by embedding Google Maps and Google earth and the ability to toggle between map types. The website was used for near-real-time tracking of a high altitude balloon, or HAB, during a launch. 

As part of the HAB team, I was also given the task to hack a gps device with a BASIC Stamp micro controller.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
This internship was my first step into web development. I dove right in and started learning how
to program with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery and PHP.

During the course of the internship, I developed a cloud based card creator for a network security board game. In the process I started developing my own library in PHP using the GD Graphics Library for manipulating and creating customized card images.

Using the card creator, players could customize a card and print it for use during game play.
